$comment: LazySitter tier -> Cursor model IDs. Baked into each .cursor/agents/*.md `model:` field at install time. Edit these to change which model each tier uses, then run `lazysitter update`. `high_alt` MUST differ from `high` so the red-team does not share the build lineage's blind spots. NEVER set a Fable model in any tier (C22/R-D) — the installer refuses and falls back, but do not rely on that; `lazysitter doctor` also reports it.
